evals.name: accountex-espana-top5
evals.prompt: On va à Accountex España à Madrid en novembre pour Chift. Regarde qui sera là et sors-moi le top 5 des personnes à rencontrer avec un brief pour chacune. Le contexte du projet est dans /Users/arthurgrebertgmail.com/Documents/Corpo/gtm-harness/gtm-data/chift-test/ (context/icp.md, context/product_context.md, chift-exclusions.csv, final-accounts.csv).
evals.expected_output: Un brief markdown avec un top 5 de personnes réelles lues sur le site de l'événement, un brief par personne (où et quand, phrase d'ouverture, chemin chaud), les clients et concurrents présents, les limites, et un CSV de toutes les personnes trouvées.
assertions: A brief file named event-brief-<slug>.md and a people file named event-people-<slug>.csv are saved
The people CSV has the columns of the output format, including source_url, status, priority and why
The top 5 table contains exactly five named people, each with a company and a place or time
Every top 5 person has a source_url on the event's own site in the CSV
No company from the exclusion list (customer or competitor) appears as a target or in the top 5
Each of the five briefs has an opening line, a pre-event message under 60 words, and a warm path line
The brief has a section on who else is in the room (customers, competitors, accounts already targeted)
The brief states what was not readable or not checked
Swan and Sage are classified as customers, not targets
STEL Order and Holded are flagged as already targeted
